resources.string: Open MoonCast on your phone, tap Start casting, then select it below. Both devices must be on the same trusted home network.

Requires the MoonCast phone sender. Android’s system Cast menu does not connect here.\nH.264 SDR · stereo Opus · low-latency queues. Signed audio offset is unavailable. Stream quality applies to the next connection; actual output depends on the phone and TV.
Looking for phones on your network…
Scan finished. Rescan or enter the phone’s IPv4 address.
No new phone found. Start casting on the phone, rescan, or add its address.
Found on network · identity not yet verified
Preparing the connection… Close or Back cancels.
Could not connect. Check MoonCast on your phone and try again.
Use the private IPv4 address shown in MoonCast on your phone. An optional HTTP port may follow a colon. Only addresses on the selected local subnet can connect.
Phone IPv4 address and optional HTTP port
Enter a private IPv4 address, such as 192.168.1.20, with an optional port from 1 to 65535. Do not enter a URL or hostname.

Pair with %1$s (%2$s)?\n\nConfirm that this is your phone on a trusted local network. This TV will create and save a pairing key if needed, then show a PIN to enter in MoonCast on your phone. The phone’s certificate is remembered only after successful pairing.
Enter this PIN in the MoonCast app on %1$s.
Waiting for the phone to confirm. Keep MoonCast open on both devices. Cancel or Back stops this attempt.
Forget this phone on the TV?
Remove %1$s and its saved certificate from this TV?\n\nThis only removes the TV’s local record. It does not revoke this TV on the phone. Remote revocation is not available from this TV.
